newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish brewer Ege Biracilik to issue bonuses.
newsitem.headline: Turkish brewer Ege Biracilik to issue bonuses.

text.p: Turkish brewery Ege Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii AS said its executive board decided to raise capital by issuing bonus shares.

In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, the company said it would distribute a 0.35 bonus for one existing share in order to increase its capital to 2.13 trillion lira from 1.58 trillion lira.
The capital increase will be met from revalued fixed assets, equity participations and premiums from share sales.
Ege Biracilik is part of Turkish brewery, beverage, automotive and stationery group Anadolu Endustri Holding which produces Turkey's leading Efes Pilsen brand with four malt and beer plants.
